Chapter 797: Chapter 15 Void Creatures (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 797: Chapter 15 Void Creatures (Subscribe Please)

The space within the scroll was only a thousand miles in radius.

Lin Yuan glanced over it.

And discovered that in the central location, there were two high platforms situated.

At the same time.

Two messages transmitted from the two platforms.

The message from the left platform was—

...

“All life from the Boundless Void can use this token to enter the Void Secret Realm and slay Void Creatures.”

This message was very simple.

It was purely just a message, without any pressure, without any mystique, but the first sentence ‘All life from the Boundless Void’ suggested quite a grand scope.

The Boundless Void was vast and endless; Evil Gods were considered life of the Boundless Void, as were some other special existences.

Simply put, any life born in the Boundless Void was considered as such.

Even Lin Yuan could be considered half a life of the Boundless Void.

His Martial Ancestor Golden Body was also nurtured from the Boundless Void.

“Void Secret Realm? Slaying Void Creatures? What are these Void Creatures? Is it just simple slaughter?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If there were no benefits, who would fight these so-called ‘Void Creatures’ given the selfish and self-interested nature of the Foreign Evil Gods?

But from Lin Yuan’s Soul Search of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, there was both fear and longing for that Void Secret Realm.

“There must be some major benefit.”

Lin Yuan thought inwardly, as the memories of the Black Demon Pavilion Master regarding the Void Secret Realm were similarly obscured.

Yet from the fluctuating emotions, one could infer a lot of information.

“The Void Secret Realm is probably in that location.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze looked distantly in a certain direction.

The message from the left platform also contained the precise coordinates of the Boundless Void.

Moreover, the memories of the Black Demon Pavilion Master had the general location of that Void Secret Realm.

…

Compared to the brief message from the left platform,

The message from the right platform was many times more complex.

“Is this a Secret Technique? A Body Refinement Secret Technique?”

Lin Yuan showed a trace of surprise; ‘Xuanhuang Physique’, which he cultivated, was indeed one of the top Body Refinement Secret Techniques.

Cultivated to the extreme, it was powerful enough to traverse the Twelfth Rank.

“It’s less detailed than ‘Xuanhuang Physique’, but the limit seems high, and it requires a profound understanding of the Material Law.”

Lin Yuan browsed briefly.

The Material Law, being one of the fundamental laws, is the basis of all matter, and flesh and blood are naturally part of that matter.

The practice of ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ also requires understanding the Material Law, but Lin Yuan had already thoroughly comprehended it.

“That Black Demon Pavilion Master has not cultivated this Body Refinement Secret Technique deeply, otherwise, he would have already stepped into the Tenth Rank. Is it because his understanding of the Material Law is insufficient?”

Lin Yuan mused.

Evil Gods of the Boundless Void possess many innate abilities, essentially incarnations of laws, but to have these Evil Gods understand other laws was an almost impossible task.

Many Evil Gods couldn’t even maintain their own sanity all the time.

“This Body Refinement Secret Technique could be worthy of reference.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly; even if it wasn’t as good as ‘Xuanhuang Physique’, the two methodologies refined the body from completely different perspectives and both had their merits.

…

Next.

Lin Yuan proceeded to inventory all the remaining spoils of war.

And began to finish viewing the memories of the remaining three Evil Gods.

The four Evil Gods including the Black Demon Pavilion Master, standing at the pinnacle of this region, naturally had a good understanding of the nearby intelligence.

Add to that the memories of the Ancestral Demon Tree itself.

Lin Yuan immediately had a general impression of the vast Boundless Void.

Firstly, the Boundless Void had no end; even the Evil Gods did not know the actual size and scope to this day.

According to the memories of the several Evil Gods, the Boundless Void is divided into numerous Void Domains, and the current Void Domain where the Tianqing World is located is named the ‘Three Yin Void Domain’.

The strongest Evil God of the Three Yin Void Domain is the ‘Lord of the Three Yin’, very close to being a Ninth Stage Evil God.

Even the four Evil Gods, including the Black Demon Pavilion Master, were nominally under that ‘Lord of the Three Yin’.

“Lord of the Three Yin?”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew slightly solemn, as in the memories of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, there was immense wariness, even fear, towards that Lord of the Three Yin.

“Does that Lord of the Three Yin at least have the strength of the Tenth Rank Summit, or has one foot already stepped into Tier 11?”

Lin Yuan was only slightly more serious; with his current strength, once he activated the Divine Ability ‘World’…

Even if all aspects of his foundation are not as strong as his Main Universe true body, he could still suppress the first and second tiers of the Eleventh Rank.

Unless faced directly with a Ninth Stage Evil God, there was nothing that Lin Yuan feared.

Moreover, even if it was a Ninth Stage Evil God, the threat to Lin Yuan was very limited, and retreating unscathed if unable to win was not a problem at all.

…

After sorting everything out.

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly, and the Door to the Myriad Realms in the depths of his mind rippled faintly as the Mysterious Gourd slowly descended across dimensions.

“In addition to cultivating, I will also elevate the Inner World to its limits,” Lin Yuan picked up the Mysterious Gourd.

With the premise of realm sharing, this Martial Ancestor Golden Body as well as both Primordial Spirits, after absorbing the seven-colored liquid from the Mysterious Gourd, could easily do so in a short time.

The size and the depth of the Inner World now had a profound impact on Lin Yuan’s strength, and the might of the Divine Ability ‘World’ was entirely dependent on the Inner World.

…

In a part of the Three Yin Void Domain, within a majestic hall.

The Lord of the Three Yin sat high on his throne, with many subservient Evil Gods kneeling below.

As the ruler of a Void Domain, the strength of the Lord of the Three Yin was unquestionable, and the renown among the Evil Gods wasn’t something that could be tricked or taken lightly—it was earned through slaughter.
